outputs.label: receipt
outputs.body: Cell{ type: { codeHash: RECEIPT, args: {{pledge_code_hash 32B}} }, data(80B): {{amount}} ‖ {{backer}} ‖ {{campaign_hash}} ‖ {{deadline}} }

body.zh: type code_hash = args[0..32] 的第一个 data ≥ 72B 的输出
body.en: first output with type code_hash = args[0..32] and data ≥ 72B

label.zh: receipt data 字节布局（创建时 80B）
label.en: receipt data byte layout (80B at creation)

cond.zh: 输出中存在匹配的 pledge cell
cond.en: a matching pledge cell exists in outputs

cond.zh: pledge lock args ≥ 72B，且 [0..32] / [32..40] 与 receipt 一致
cond.en: pledge lock args ≥ 72B and [0..32] / [32..40] match the receipt

title.en: Destroy receipt to reclaim its deposit

body.zh: data ≥ 40B；80B 版本含 campaign 字段
body.en: data ≥ 40B; the 80B form carries campaign fields

body.zh: campaign 已结算时任意；否则需同时消耗 pledge 且有一个给 backer 的输出 {{capacity ≥ amount − 1 CKB}}
body.en: any once the campaign is settled; otherwise a pledge must be consumed and one backer output has {{capacity ≥ amount − 1 CKB}}

cond.zh: （80B 版本）cell_deps 中有该 campaign 且 status ≠ 0，或 since 为绝对区块号 ≥ deadline + 1,944,000 → 直接通过
cond.en: (80B form) campaign in cell_deps with status ≠ 0, or since absolute block ≥ deadline + 1,944,000 → passes

cond.zh: 否则输入中须有 type code_hash = args[0..32] 的 pledge
cond.en: otherwise an input with type code_hash = args[0..32] (pledge) is required

cond.zh: 存在单个 lock hash = backer 的输出 capacity ≥ amount − 1 CKB
cond.en: a single output with lock hash = backer has capacity ≥ amount − 1 CKB

notes.zh: 创建时只检查第一个 group 输出与找到的第一个 pledge 输出
notes.en: Creation checks only the first group output and the first pledge output found

notes.zh: receipt 只保护押金，不能凭它取走认捐资金
notes.en: A receipt only guards its own deposit; it cannot release pledged funds

notes.zh: 解码器限制：cell_deps 数据不解析，“已结算”分支显示为未检查
notes.en: Decoder limitation: cell_dep data is not resolved, so the settled branch shows as not checked
